title: PopuLoRA: Co-Evolving LLM Populations for Reasoning Self- Play
originalTitle: PopuLoRA: Co-Evolving LLM Populations for Reasoning Self- Play
content:
Vmax is developing AI capable of open-ended learning. We are building systems to exceed humans in all capacities by optimising beyond the local maxima of learning from human expertise. Our approach is to let agents define and optimize goals they define themselves. We do not seek to substitute human labor for machine labor, but rather find radically new ways to do work.

We are hiring researchers with a deep expertise in reinforcement learning, and a keen interest in bringing its more esoteric aspects to real applications.

Read PopuLoRA: Co-Evolving LLM Populations for Reasoning Self-Play
